name: Cleansing Ward
description:
You touch a creature. For the next hour, any time a spell would impose effects upon the creature which last 1 round or longer, all of the spell's effects instead end at the start of the creature's next turn.

Describe how you cast the ward.

improvements.name: Shared Ward
improvements.description: You may spend 2 additional MP to extend the benefits of this spell to one additional creature you touch.
